proof_roadmap: 第 1 步：For reductio, let \alpha be the least infinite ordinal for which this is false. \olref[sfr][siz][zigzag]natsquaredenumerable shows that \cardeq\omega\omega\times\omega, so \omega \in \alpha. Moreover, \alpha is a cardinal: suppose otherwise

第 2 步：Now, for each \tuple\gamma_1, \gamma_2 \in \alpha \times \alpha, consider the segment: \beginalign* \textSeg(\gamma_1, \gamma_2) &= \Setabs\tuple\delta_1, \delta_2 \in \alpha \times \alpha\tuple\delta_1, \delta_2 \canonord \tuple\gamma_1, \
difficulty_reason: H2: the author introduces a canonical well-order on ordinal pairs, takes a least infinite counterexample, proves that counterexample must be an initial ordinal/cardinal, and bounds each proper canonical-order initial segment by a smaller ordinal square. The order-type bound then yields the required injection and Schroder-Bernstein closes the argument. The canonical-order definition and proof are included as core. This is a nonroutine well-order/initial-segment construction, not just the elementary squeeze corollary. The producer description of a successor/limit case split is not the actual route and is preserved only as historical metadata.

editorial_notes: All mathematical statement and proof text is reproduced verbatim from the Open Logic Project, unit set-theory, file simp.tex, fixed at commit 1e960beff9ed7835bf3e3f1335e21af3439cd107. Only the packaging (the adapter preamble and the standalone wrapper) is this module's.
Numbering inside this standalone excerpt is editorial, not the Open Logic Project print numbering.

The adapter preamble loads the project's OWN style layer verbatim (sty/open-logic-formulas.sty, sty/open-logic-tokenize.sty, sty/open-logic-selective.sty and open-logic-config.sty, including its tag truth assignment), so the author's !! text-token shorthand, !A math metavariables, rule names (Intro, Elim, FalseInt) and the tag conditionals resolve exactly as in the book. Three substitutions are forced by the pinned toolchain and are recorded: isomath.sty is absent so \mathsfit is \mathsf; xpunctuate.sty is absent and unused so its RequirePackage is dropped; thmtools/ntheorem are absent so the environments are amsthm with the project's family numbering. The proof trees are the project's own bussproofs-extra.

The H2 judgement and its reason were made in this module by reading the author's own statement and complete proof at the pinned line span. Original candidate key: set-theory/card-arithmetic|simp.tex|alphatimesalpha.

Reference labels in the proof resolve to navigation pointers to the original author source; these pointers do not reproduce proofs of the prerequisites. The author's own ollabel is kept unprefixed (not part:chapter:section) so those pointers resolve; the label text itself is the author's own argument.

producer_original_difficulty_reason: 作者的证明走反证并自撰了极小反例的层次论证：取最小的无穷序数 α 使 α 与 α 乘 α 不等势，先由已证的可数情形得 ω 属于 α，再证 α 是基数（若不然其基数小于 α 会给出更小的反例），随后按 α 是后继或极限分情形构造 α 到 α 乘 α 的单射，最后用 Schroder-Bernstein 收尾。判 H2。
